none: PAS SWYOR-4F43DB: Roman coin; radiate of Victorinvs
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin: a radiate of Victorinus dating from AD 268 - 270(Reece period 13). The reverse legend INVICTVS, the reverse depicting Sol, running left, with right arm raised and holding a whip in the left hand. His cloak flies out behind. There is a star in the left field.
